Demonstrates the use of 5G networks for a cloud-assisted connected and automated mobility service in the EU H2020 5G-MOBIX project, with preliminary field tests of the autonomous truck routing use case at the Ford Otosan test track in Eskişehir, Türkiye.

Research area: [Reinforcement Learning & Autonomous Systems](/research/rl-autonomy/).
